verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a durable-execution server, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents a way to export all data in open formats or to migrate off the product. The Introspection SQL API, the CLI, trace export and the self-hosting options are related inspection and deployment features, not a documented full-data export, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
